pages.title: Horn Protection
pages.text: A Dragon Soul Horn resists fire, lava, explosions, cacti, and natural despawning. Upgrade a Dragon Horn to make one.

pages.title: Upgrading a Horn
pages.text: Horn center; gold on four sides; Eyes of Ender above, scales below, in the corners. Scales may differ; filled horns retain their dragon's data.

pages.title: Recovering a Dropped Horn
pages.text: A horn dropped in lava floats; one falling into the void rises back and waits near the world's bottom.$(br2)Retrieve it and use it on the ground to release the dragon. A severely injured companion still cannot enter the horn and needs care outside it.
